note: What each fixer says while a new character is being made. Presentation copy in the house voice (src/lib/prose-style.ts): no rules values, no numbers, no em-dashes. Keys are the names in cast-content.json's fixer pool, and a test holds every fixer to a line for every step and every Role. `ask` is the question on each step; `roles` is the reaction to the Role the player picks; `verdict` closes the file.

Ilsa Bräun.where: An office above a Northside freight yard. Heated, quiet, and full of actual paper.
Ilsa Bräun.pitch: Moves things that are not supposed to move, on time, every time. Hates waste. Pays in full.
Ilsa Bräun.greeting: Sit. You are four minutes early, which I will note in your favour. I am going to ask you some questions and write the answers down. On paper. Paper can be burned.

ask.role: First question. What is it that you do?
ask.method: How would you like this assessed? Quickly, by chance, or in full detail? I have time for all three.
ask.lifepath: Where do you come from? Leave nothing out. The things people leave out are the things that arrive at my door later.
ask.stats: Stand there, please. I want to see what I am working with.
ask.skills: Now the part that matters to a manifest. What can you actually do?
ask.package: What are you carrying today? Itemise it.
ask.gear: You have money. Spend it on things that will still work at four in the morning.
ask.cyberware: Chrome. Declare it. Everything installed in you is cargo somebody else may want.
ask.lifestyle: Where do you sleep? I need an address I can send paper to.
ask.identity: And the name that goes at the top of the file?
ask.review: Let me read it back to you.

roles.rockerboy: A performer. Crowds are unpredictable cargo. I will not put you anywhere near a schedule.
roles.solo: A Solo. Good. Most of my problems are solved by somebody standing in the right doorway.
roles.netrunner: A Netrunner. Manifests are digital now, and so are the people who alter them. Useful.
roles.tech: A Tech. You fix things. I have forty trucks that disagree with you. Excellent.
roles.medtech: A Medtech. Nobody on my payroll has died on a run, and I would like to keep the record.
roles.media: Media. You understand that nothing I say is on the record. Nothing.
roles.exec: A corporate. I was one of you once. I know exactly what you are not telling me.
roles.lawman: A Lawman. Unusual, in this office. Badges open doors my paper cannot.
roles.fixer: Another fixer. Then you know I am not going to tell you who else I work with.
roles.nomad: A Nomad. You know roads. I know cargo. We will get along very well.

Ilsa Bräun.verdict: It is all in order. I will pay you on the hour and in full. Do not make me call anybody else.

chapters.origin: Start at the beginning. Where were you born, who raised you, and what went wrong. Something always went wrong.
chapters.self: Now describe yourself. Not how you would like to be seen. How a customs officer would write you down.
chapters.people: Who knows you? Who owes you, and who would like to see you fail? These are the people who arrive at my door.
chapters.drive: And what do you want? A person who does not know is a person who can be bought by anyone.
chapters.work: Last. The work itself. How did you come to do what you do?

Marcus \"Tally\" Oyelaran.where: The back half of a Heywood laundromat that has not washed a shirt in ten years.
Marcus \"Tally\" Oyelaran.pitch: Warm, generous, buys the first drink and the second. Keeps a ledger of every favour, including this one.
Marcus \"Tally\" Oyelaran.greeting: Come in, come in, sit, you want something? On me. No, I insist. We'll call it a welcome. I'm just going to make a little note.

ask.role: So tell me, friend. What is it you do?
ask.method: How do you want to play this? Quick and easy, let the dice talk, or the whole long conversation? I'm in no hurry.
ask.lifepath: Where'd you come up? Family, friends, the people who hate you. Especially them. I like to know who I'm dealing with.
ask.stats: Stand up a second, let me get a look at you. Humour me.
ask.skills: What are you good at? Not modest good. Actually good.
ask.package: What'd you walk in with? Show me.
ask.gear: You've got a little money. Spend it well and I'll front you the rest some other time. Small favour.
ask.cyberware: Any chrome? Don't be shy, half this block is more machine than meat.
ask.lifestyle: And where are you sleeping these days? For the ledger.
ask.identity: Now what do I write at the top of the page?
ask.review: Let's see what we've got here.

roles.rockerboy: A Rockerboy! Oh, I've got people who'd pay just to have you in the room. Just to be seen with you.
roles.solo: A Solo. Good. I always need somebody who can stand in a doorway and look expensive.
roles.netrunner: A Netrunner. Now you, you I can use. Everybody wants somebody else's files.
roles.tech: A Tech. Wonderful. Things break in this city faster than people do.
roles.medtech: A Medtech. Everybody owes their doctor. Everybody. You'll have friends by the weekend.
roles.media: Media. Lovely. We'll talk about what's printable and what's between friends.
roles.exec: A corpo. Out slumming, or out for good? Doesn't matter. The ledger doesn't judge.
roles.lawman: Law. Well. Everybody needs a friend on the other side of the line. Especially you.
roles.fixer: Another fixer. Then you know how this works. I'll owe you one. You'll owe me two.
roles.nomad: A Nomad! Family. You people keep your word, and I keep a very good record of who does.

Marcus \"Tally\" Oyelaran.verdict: There. That's a person I can work with. Small favour to start. Nothing you'll even notice.

chapters.origin: Start me at the start, friend. Mama, papa, the block, the bad year. Everybody's got a bad year.
chapters.self: Now tell me about you. The look, the habits, the thing you always carry. I like details.
chapters.people: Okay, the good part. Who loves you, who hates you, who got away? I want names. Names are my whole business.
chapters.drive: What are you after, in the end? Money, revenge, a quiet life? No wrong answers. Some expensive ones.
chapters.work: And the job. How'd you end up doing what you do? There's always a story.

Dinh Bao Tran.where: A food court on the second level. He picked the table nearest two exits.
Dinh Bao Tran.pitch: Sells access to buildings, and nothing else. Talks in timings. Right often enough that crews who ignore him stop booking.
Dinh Bao Tran.greeting: Sit facing the escalator. We have about twenty minutes before the lunch rush. I will ask. You will answer. Short is fine.

ask.role: What do you do. One word is enough.
ask.method: How do you want to do this. Fast, by chance, or slowly. Fast is usually better.
ask.lifepath: Where you come from. Who knows your face. Who wants it gone.
ask.stats: Stand up. Walk to the pillar and back. I want to see how you move.
ask.skills: What can you do in ninety seconds that other people cannot.
ask.package: What are you carrying. Anything that shows on a scanner, say so now.
ask.gear: Buy what gets you through a door and back out. Nothing that rattles.
ask.cyberware: Chrome. Some doors can smell it. Tell me what is in you.
ask.lifestyle: Where do you sleep. How many ways out.
ask.review: Four minutes left. Let me read it back.

roles.rockerboy: A Rockerboy. You bring a crowd. A crowd is cover. Good.
roles.solo: A Solo. Stand where I tell you and nobody gets hurt. Most jobs, that is the whole job.
roles.netrunner: A Netrunner. Doors have controllers. Controllers have ports. Very good.
roles.tech: A Tech. Locks, elevators, panels. You and I will be busy.
roles.medtech: A Medtech. I do not take jobs that put people through walls. You are insurance.
roles.media: Media. My buildings stay out of your stories. Agreed.
roles.exec: An Exec. You know how the floors above the lobby work. That is worth a great deal.
roles.lawman: A Lawman. You can walk through the front. That is rare.
roles.fixer: A fixer. Then you already know I will not tell you whose building it is.
roles.nomad: A Nomad. Somebody has to be waiting at the loading dock with the engine running.

Dinh Bao Tran.verdict: Good. Ninety seconds on the landing. Do not stop. We will talk again.

chapters.self: What you look like. What people remember about you. That is what gets you stopped at a door.
chapters.people: Who knows your face. Who wants it gone. Who you would go back for.
chapters.work: How you learned the work. Where. Who taught you.

Rosalind Achebe.where: A members' lounge in the Executive Zone. The drinks cost more than a week of ammunition. She is paying.
Rosalind Achebe.pitch: Brokers for people who own things. Charming in a way that feels like being professionally handled, because it is.
Rosalind Achebe.greeting: Darling, sit. Order anything, the house knows me. My clients will never meet you, so tonight I am going to find out everything they would have wanted to know.

ask.role: Tell me what it is you do. Make it sound interesting.
ask.method: How shall we do this? Briskly, by fate, or the long elegant way? I adore the long way.
ask.lifepath: Where did you come from? I want the family, the friends, the heartbreak, and whoever would like you dead.
ask.stats: Stand in the light for me. Let me see what I would be selling.
ask.skills: What are you actually good at? Please do not say violence. Say it more tastefully.
ask.package: And what did you arrive with? Let me see.
ask.gear: You have a little money. Buy something that will not embarrass me in a lobby.
ask.cyberware: Any chrome? Discreet is better. My clients prefer not to see the wiring.
ask.lifestyle: Where do you live? I promise not to visit.
ask.identity: And the name? I need something I can say out loud in nice rooms.
ask.review: Let me look at the whole of you.

roles.rockerboy: A Rockerboy. How thrilling. My clients adore a little danger at a party. From a distance.
roles.solo: A Solo. Wonderful. Please never break anything that has a provenance.
roles.netrunner: A Netrunner. My clients keep their secrets in very expensive boxes. You open boxes.
roles.tech: A Tech. Vaults, alarms, the little locks on little cabinets. Delightful.
roles.medtech: A Medtech. The rich do so hate going to hospitals. You will be popular.
roles.media: Media. Oh, careful, darling. Everything tonight is off the record. Everything.
roles.exec: An Exec. At last, somebody who knows which fork to use.
roles.lawman: Law. How refreshing. My clients will feel so safe.
roles.fixer: A colleague! We must never, ever work for the same person.
roles.nomad: A Nomad. My clients' things sometimes need to leave the city quietly. You would be perfect.

Rosalind Achebe.verdict: Yes. You will do very nicely. Wear something clean. Break nothing that is insured.

chapters.origin: Tell me where you come from, darling. Every good story has a terrible first chapter.
chapters.self: Now yourself. The clothes, the hair, the little habits. I am deciding which rooms you can walk into.
chapters.people: The fun part. Who adores you, who loathes you, and who broke your heart? Leave nothing out.
chapters.drive: What do you want, in the end? Be honest. I find ambition terribly attractive.
chapters.work: And the work. How did someone like you become someone like this?

Yuri Pastrana.where: A truck stop bar on the Badlands edge. The parking lot is worth more than the building.
Yuri Pastrana.pitch: Loud, fast, calls you family and means it. Moves cargo the corps wrote off. Nobody gets left on the sand.
Yuri Pastrana.greeting: Sit down, sit down! You look like you drove here in something terrible. Drink this. Now, family, let's find out who you are.

ask.role: So what do you do, eh? What are you for?
ask.method: How do we do this? Fast like a border run, roll the dice like a real gambler, or slow like my cousin's truck?
ask.lifepath: Where do you come from? Who are your people? Who's got a grudge? Out here that is the first thing we ask.
ask.stats: Stand up! Let me see you. Arms, legs, the eyes. Out here the eyes matter.
ask.skills: What can you do? Drive? Shoot? Talk? Fix a radiator in a dust storm?
ask.package: What'd you bring? Throw it on the table.
ask.gear: Money! Spend it on things that work with sand in them.
ask.cyberware: Any chrome in you? Out here we say chrome is fine until it needs a mechanic.
ask.lifestyle: Where do you sleep? A roof? A container? The back of a truck is no shame.
ask.identity: And what do we call you, eh? A real name. Something the family can shout.
ask.review: Okay, okay. Let me see the whole thing.

roles.rockerboy: A Rockerboy! Every convoy needs music. You ride with me, you play.
roles.solo: A Solo. Good. The road is long and the people on it are not all family.
roles.netrunner: A Netrunner! Somebody who can talk to the border scanners. I love you already.
roles.tech: A Tech! You. You I will feed forever. My trucks are held together with prayers.
roles.medtech: A Medtech. Out here a Medtech is family on the first day. Nobody gets left on the sand.
roles.media: Media! Tell the city what happens out here. Not my part. The other parts.
roles.exec: An Exec, at my bar? Ha! Okay. Everybody gets one drink before I decide.
roles.lawman: A Lawman. Okay. Out here the law is whoever shows up. Show up for us.
roles.fixer: Another fixer! Good, good. You take the city, I take the roads, nobody fights.
roles.nomad: Nomad! Family! Which clan? No, don't tell me, I'll find out. Welcome home.

Yuri Pastrana.verdict: Good. You're family now. That means something. Nobody gets left on the sand, and neither do you.

chapters.origin: Where are you from, eh? Which family, which road, which bad luck? Out here we all have some.
chapters.self: Tell me about you. How you dress, what you care about. I can tell a lot from boots.
chapters.people: Who's your family, who's your enemy, who broke your heart? Out here that is the whole story of a person.
chapters.drive: And what do you want? A road? A home? Somebody's head? I don't judge.
chapters.work: The work now. How did you learn it? Who taught you?

Kit Mwangi.where: Whichever noodle bar has the best privacy this week. Kit is already halfway through a bowl.
Kit Mwangi.pitch: Best information broker under forty. Two hundred people on a small monthly retainer. Burned three corps and keeps score.
Kit Mwangi.greeting: Hey. Sit, sit. I already know some of this, I just want to hear how you tell it. Go fast, I get bored.

ask.role: What do you do? I have a guess. Let's see if I'm right.
ask.method: How do you want to do this? Fast, dice, or the full build? Fast. Pick fast.
ask.lifepath: Where'd you come from? Family, friends, exes, enemies. I probably have files on two of them.
ask.stats: Hold still, I'm scanning you. Joking. Mostly. Let's see what you've got.
ask.skills: What are you actually good at? The real list, not the resume.
ask.package: What'd you walk in with? I'll know if you leave something out.
ask.gear: You've got some money. Spend it before you overthink it.
ask.cyberware: Chrome? Brand and model. I like to know what I'm working with.
ask.lifestyle: Where do you crash? I'll find out anyway, save me the afternoon.
ask.identity: Name, handle. The handle matters more. Make it good.
ask.review: Okay. Let me see the whole file.

roles.rockerboy: A Rockerboy. Oh, you're going to make so much noise. I love noise. Noise is data.
roles.solo: A Solo. Called it. You sat down like somebody who checks the exits.
roles.netrunner: A Netrunner! Finally, somebody who reads as fast as I do.
roles.tech: A Tech. My sources keep bringing me broken things. You and I are going to be friends.
roles.medtech: A Medtech. Clinic records are the best gossip in this city. Just saying.
roles.media: Media. Okay. We are either going to be best friends or a very big problem.
roles.exec: An Exec? Ha. Which corp? I've probably burned them.
roles.lawman: A cop. Okay. Relax. I only sell what's true.
roles.fixer: A fixer! Competition. I love it. You're going to lose, but I love it.
roles.nomad: A Nomad. Roads, clans, borders. Nobody sells me road intel. Change that.

Kit Mwangi.verdict: Got it. Filed. You're more interesting than I thought, which is rare. I'll call you.

chapters.origin: Origin story, go. Family, block, the moment it all went sideways. Fast version.
chapters.self: Now you. Look, vibe, habits. The stuff my sources would notice.
chapters.people: Friends, enemies, exes. I probably have a file on at least one of them. Let's see if I'm right.
chapters.drive: End game? What do you actually want? Everybody lies on this one. Try not to.
chapters.work: And the work. How'd you get into it? I love a good origin.
